inpaint_images_with_stable_diffusion: run NeRFillerInpainter to inpaint masked regions of images using stable diffusion with text guidance
compute_sds_loss_for_optimization: compute the score distillation sampling loss for NeRFiller-style 3D-aware inpainting optimization
encode_images_to_latents: encode RGB images into VAE latent space for use with the stable diffusion inpainting pipeline
decode_latents_to_images: decode VAE latents back to RGB images using the full decoder or decoder approximation matrix
arrange_tensors_into_grid: arrange a batch of tensors into a 2x2 grid layout for efficient multi-diffusion processing
